name: vyomi
description: Run and test cloud code locally against Vyomi, the AWS/GCP/Azure simulator (Nano in your browser, or a Pro/Max mesh): find your simulator, scan a repo, see what is emulated where, wire SDKs to it, and tell every coding agent about it via AGENTS.md. Needs vyomi-tunnel 1.3.0 or newer.

interface.shortDescription: Run AWS, GCP and Azure code locally against the Vyomi simulator
interface.longDescription: Scan a repo for AWS / GCP / Azure usage, see which services Vyomi emulates in your Nano tab or Pro/Max mesh, write a dev-only .env.vyomi, and add a Vyomi section to AGENTS.md so every coding agent runs against the simulator instead of the real cloud.
defaultPrompt: Set this project up to run against Vyomi.
